## Resolution — 2026-11-11

The requested upgrade is already present on [main `48d0fb9a5651`](https://github.com/billlza/q-periapt/commit/48d0fb9a5651b50494ec33d025dda52bd2ff5eae). All three changed manifests use `getrandom = "0.4"`, and the locked dependencies of `q-periapt-ffi`, `q-periapt-policy-agent`, and `q-periapt-tls-demo` resolve to `getrandom 0.4.3`. The 0.4.3 registry checksum also matches this PR. Closing this duplicate upgrade after comparing all four changed files with main.

## Resolution — 2026-11-11

The requested `rustls 0.23.43` update has been superseded on [main `48d0fb9a5651`](https://github.com/billlza/q-periapt/commit/48d0fb9a5651b50494ec33d025dda52bd2ff5eae), whose `Cargo.lock` resolves `rustls 0.23.46`. This PR changes only the rustls version and checksum in that lockfile. Closing the superseded update to retain the newer version already on main.

## Resolution — 2026-11-11

The requested TOML upgrade is already resolved on [main `48d0fb9a5651`](https://github.com/billlza/q-periapt/commit/48d0fb9a5651b50494ec33d025dda52bd2ff5eae): `toml 1.1.4+spec-1.1.0`, `serde_spanned 1.1.1`, `toml_datetime 1.1.1+spec-1.1.0`, `toml_parser 1.1.3+spec-1.1.0`, `toml_writer 1.1.2+spec-1.1.0`, and `winnow 1.0.4` match the target lock entries and checksums in this PR. The policy manifest already selects the compatible major version with `toml = "1"`; this PR's spelling is `"1.1"`. Closing the duplicate version upgrade after comparing both changed files with main.
